summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of SKh Pelita Al-Karomah MVP. 18/18 pytest backend tests pass covering settings, news CRUD, programs, teachers, events, gallery (+filter), PPDB submit + ref_no format, admin auth, admin stats, settings update, PPDB status update, 401 on protected endpoints. Frontend Playwright verified: homepage renders (hero, 6 program cards, 3 news cards), text-size toggle applies 'text-size-large' class on <html>, all 7 navbar routes navigate, PPDB form submits and displays ref_no (PPDB-2026-0002), admin login works and lands on /admin dashboard (stat-news=3), admin news CRUD (add/save/delete visible with 4 delete buttons after seed+create), admin PPDB list contains submitted TEST_UI_Siswa, admin Pengaturan save button present, protected /admin redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated, mobile 390px hamburger opens menu with all nav links, no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS env is '*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject cookies); currently works because Bearer token fallback is used. Consider setting explicit origin(s) if cookie-based auth is required cross-origin.

ui_bugs.issue: Title input inside 'Tambah Berita' modal lacks a data-testid (e.g., news-title-input); tests had to fall back to [role=dialog] input:first. Add data-testid for stability.
Default settings.logo_url is empty string, causing '' console warning triggering a full page re-download. Render logo only when logo_url is truthy, or pass null.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/auth/me returns 401 twice on every public page load (React StrictMode double-invocation) flooding the console. Skip the call if no token/localStorage 'skh_token' is present.

action_items: Frontend: guard Navbar logo to avoid empty src warning
Frontend: in AuthContext, avoid calling /api/auth/me if no token is stored (reduces console 401 noise)
Frontend: add data-testid=news-title-input (and other form fields) inside admin Berita modal
Backend: consider setting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origin(s) instead of '*' when using allow_credentials=True
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes CORSMiddleware after router include which is fine, but allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is a spec violation; browsers will silently drop credentials.
server.py PPDB ref_no uses count_documents()+1 which is race-condition prone under concurrency; consider an atomic counter (findAndModify) or use uuid-based ref numbers.
server.py is a single ~640 line file mixing models, auth, routes, seed. Consider splitting into routers/models/seed modules once app grows.

Admin PUT endpoints accept raw dict without validation; malicious payloads could set arbitrary fields (e.g., role escalation is not applicable here, but pattern is fragile). Use Pydantic partial models.
seed_admin refreshes password if changed - good; but idempotent seeding of demo data uses count()==0 check which is fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Created test PPDB entries (TEST_UI_Siswa, TEST_StatusFlow), test news items via CRUD (cleaned up in backend tests; UI-created TEST_UI_News_Item remains in DB, and one PPDB TEST_UI_Siswa remains).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Only minor frontend polish items remain (empty logo src warning, /auth/me 401 noise on public pages, missing data-testid on news modal fields). No blocking bugs.
